# Application Management

Apps (connected systems) — list, categories, configurations.

3 operation(s). Base URL `https://vannbros-qa.burqio.site`; `{version}` in a path is `1`. Calls need `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (see ../SKILL.md). **Read-only for QA:** only GETs, and not the GETs SKILL.md lists as side-effecting.

<a id="op-apps-getall"></a>
### GET `/api/v{version}/Apps`

operationId `Apps_GetAll` · Retrieves all applications with optional filtering and pagination

| Param | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PageNumber` | query | int32 |  | non-nullable (omitted → server default, e.g. 0/false); Gets or sets the page number for pagination. Default is 1. |
| `PageSize` | query | int32 |  | non-nullable (omitted → server default, e.g. 0/false); Gets or sets the page size for pagination. Default is 100. |
| `AllowedOnly` | query | boolean |  | non-nullable (omitted → server default, e.g. 0/false); Gets or sets a value indicating whether to retrieve only allowed applications. Default is true. |
| `version` | path | string | yes |  |

Request body: _none_

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [PaginatedResultOfGetAllApplicationsResponse](#schema-paginatedresultofgetallapplicationsresponse) | Applications retrieved successfully |
| `401` | [ProblemDetails](#schema-problemdetails) | Unauthorized - user must have Apps.View permission |
| `500` | [PaginatedResultOfGetAllApplicationsResponse](#schema-paginatedresultofgetallapplicationsresponse) | Internal server error |
